title: E2DT: Efficient and Effective Decision Transformer with Experience-Aware Sampling for Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: E2DT：面向机器人操作的高效有效决策Transformer与经验感知采样
abstract: In reinforcement learning (RL) for robotic manipulation, the Decision Transformer (DT) has emerged as an effective framework for addressing long-horizon tasks. However, DT’s performance depends heavily on the coverage of collected experiences. Without an active exploration mechanism, standard DT relies on uniform replay, which leads to poor sample efficiency, limited exploration, and reduced overall effectiveness. At the same time, while excessive exploration can help avoid local optima, it often delays policy convergence and leads to degraded efficiency. To address these limitations, we propose E2DT, a DT-guided k-Determinantal Point Process sampling framework that enables the model to actively shape its own experience selection. Our framework is experience-aware, allowing E2DT to be both efficient, by prioritizing sampling quality (e.g., high-return, high-uncertainty, and underrepresented trajectories), and effective, by ensuring diversity across trajectory windows to preserve policy optimality. Specifically, DT’s internal latent embeddings measure diversity across trajectory windows, while quality is quantified through a composite metric that integrates return-to-go (RTG) quantiles, predictive uncertainty, and stage coverage (inverse frequency). These two dimensions are integrated into a novel quality–diversity joint kernel that prioritizes the most informative experiences, thereby enabling learning that is both efficient and effective. We evaluate E2DT on challenging robotic manipulation benchmarks in both simulation and real-robot settings. Results show that it consistently outperforms prior methods. These findings demonstrate that coupling policy learning with experience-aware sampling provides a principled path toward robust long-horizon robotic learning.
abstract_zh: 在机器人操作的强化学习（RL）中，决策Transformer（DT）已成为解决长时域任务的有效框架。然而，DT的性能严重依赖于所收集经验覆盖范围。在没有主动探索机制的情况下，标准DT依赖均匀回放，导致样本效率低、探索受限且整体效果下降。同时，虽然过度探索有助于避免局部最优，但往往会延迟策略收敛并导致效率降低。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了E2DT，一种DT引导的k-行列式点过程采样框架，使模型能够主动塑造自身的经验选择。我们的框架具有经验感知能力，使E2DT既高效——通过优先考虑采样质量（例如高回报、高不确定性和代表性不足的轨迹），又有效——通过确保轨迹窗口的多样性以保持策略最优性。具体而言，DT的内部潜在嵌入衡量轨迹窗口的多样性，而质量则通过一个综合指标量化，该指标整合了回报至目标（RTG）分位数、预测不确定性和阶段覆盖（逆频率）。这两个维度被集成到一个新颖的质量-多样性联合核中，优先选择最具信息量的经验，从而实现既高效又有效的学习。我们在模拟和真实机器人设置中的挑战性机器人操作基准上评估了E2DT。结果表明，它始终优于先前方法。这些发现表明，将策略学习与经验感知采样相结合，为稳健的长时域机器人学习提供了一条原则性路径。
tldr_zh: E2DT通过经验感知采样提升决策Transformer的样本效率和探索能力。
cover_zh: 决策Transformer新突破｜经验感知采样让机器人学习效率翻倍
